annotation.title_clean: Konsultasi Publik Buku Putih Peta Jalan Kecerdasan Artifisial Nasional dan Konsep Pedoman Etika Kecerdasan Artifisial
annotation.title_en: Public Consultation on the White Paper on the National AI Roadmap and the Draft AI Ethics Guidelines
named_instruments_referenced: Indonesia Circular Letter No. 9 of 2023 on AI Ethics
annotation.summary_en: Press release from Indonesia's Ministry of Communication and Digital announcing a public consultation on the draft White Paper on the National AI Roadmap and draft AI Ethics Guidelines, with comments accepted until 22 August 2025. It builds on Circular Letter No. 9/2023 and informs future AI policy and regulation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Public consultation on the National AI Roadmap White Paper and draft AI Ethics Guidelines
Comments accepted by email until 22 August 2025
Roadmap produced by a 443-member multi-stakeholder task force
Draft guidelines strengthen Circular Letter No. 9/2023 on AI ethics
White Paper to underpin future AI policy and regulatory strategy
